answer: A payout is split thus 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The nebula schedule is applied in harbor and ridge publishes each instalment. Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1727 identities would post 1133 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
